<script>
(function () {
  var CACHE_KEY = "citationCounts.v2";
  var CACHE_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours
  var CROSSREF_MAILTO = "johnrbassler@gmail.com"; // identifies us to Crossref's "polite pool" for more reliable service

  function bareDoi(url) {
    return url.replace(/^https?:\/\/doi\.org\//i, "");
  }

  function readCache() {
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return {};
      var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object") return {};
      return parsed;
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  }

  function writeCache(cache) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cache));
    } catch (e) {
      /* localStorage unavailable or full — degrade silently */
    }
  }

  function setBadge(el, count, url) {
    if (count === null || count === undefined) {
      el.remove();
      return;
    }
    var label = count === 0 ? "Not yet cited" : "Cited by " + count.toLocaleString();
    if (url) {
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.target = "_blank";
      a.rel = "noopener";
      a.textContent = "· " + label;
      el.textContent = "";
      el.appendChild(a);
    } else {
      el.textContent = "· " + label;
    }
  }

  function delay(ms) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve) { setTimeout(resolve, ms); });
  }

  // Semantic Scholar: broadest coverage, but its shared public tier gets rate-limited (429) under load.
  // Retry twice with backoff before giving up on it for a given batch.
  function fetchSemanticScholarBatch(dois, attempt) {
    var ids = dois.map(function (d) { return "DOI:" + d; });
    return fetch("https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/batch?fields=citationCount,paperId", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ ids: ids })
    }).then(function (resp) {
      if (resp.status === 429 && attempt < 2) {
        return delay(1500 * (attempt + 1)).then(function () {
          return fetchSemanticScholarBatch(dois, attempt + 1);
        });
      }
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("Semantic Scholar status " + resp.status);
      return resp.json();
    });
  }

  // Crossref: narrower coverage (only counts citations from other Crossref-registered works),
  // but a more dependable fallback when Semantic Scholar is unavailable.
  function fetchCrossrefCount(doi) {
    var url = "https://api.crossref.org/works/" + encodeURIComponent(doi) + "?mailto=" + encodeURIComponent(CROSSREF_MAILTO);
    return fetch(url)
      .then(function (resp) {
        if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("Crossref status " + resp.status);
        return resp.json();
      })
      .then(function (data) {
        var count = data && data.message ? data.message["is-referenced-by-count"] : null;
        return typeof count === "number" ? count : null;
      })
      .catch(function () { return null; });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var badges = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".citation-badge[data-doi]"));
    if (!badges.length) return;

    var cache = readCache();
    var now = Date.now();
    var toFetch = [];

    badges.forEach(function (el) {
      var doi = bareDoi(el.getAttribute("data-doi"));
      var cached = cache[doi];
      if (cached && now - cached.t < CACHE_TTL_MS) {
        setBadge(el, cached.count, cached.url);
      } else {
        toFetch.push({ el: el, doi: doi });
      }
    });

    if (!toFetch.length) return;

    var dois = toFetch.map(function (item) { return item.doi; });

    fetchSemanticScholarBatch(dois, 0)
      .then(function (results) {
        var remaining = [];
        toFetch.forEach(function (item, i) {
          var r = results[i];
          var count = r ? r.citationCount : null;
          if (count !== null && count !== undefined) {
            var url = r.paperId ? "https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/" + r.paperId : null;
            setBadge(item.el, count, url);
            cache[item.doi] = { count: count, url: url, t: now };
          } else {
            remaining.push(item);
          }
        });
        writeCache(cache);
        return remaining;
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.warn("Semantic Scholar lookup failed, falling back to Crossref:", err);
        return toFetch;
      })
      .then(function (remaining) {
        remaining.forEach(function (item) {
          fetchCrossrefCount(item.doi).then(function (count) {
            var url = count !== null ? "https://doi.org/" + item.doi : null;
            setBadge(item.el, count, url);
            if (count !== null) {
              cache[item.doi] = { count: count, url: url, t: Date.now() };
              writeCache(cache);
            }
          });
        });
      });
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- Altmetric badge widget: renders the colored attention-score bars
     next to each peer-reviewed article. Third-party script, loaded
     once for the whole page; each individual badge is just a
     <span class="altmetric-embed"> with a data-doi attribute (added
     per-entry above) that this script finds and fills in. -->
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://embed.altmetric.com/assets/embed.js"></script>

<!-- "Copy BibTeX" buttons: each publication entry has a hidden
     <template> holding its plain-text BibTeX record. Clicking the
     button just copies that template's text to the clipboard and
     shows a brief "Copied!" confirmation on the button itself. Event
     delegation (one listener on <body>) means this works for every
     button on the page without wiring each one up individually. -->
<script>
(function () {
  document.body.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest(".bibtex-copy-btn");
    if (!btn) return;
    var template = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute("data-target"));
    if (!template) return;
    var text = template.content.textContent;

    function showCopied() {
      var original = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = "Copied!";
      btn.classList.add("bibtex-copied");
      setTimeout(function () {
        btn.textContent = original;
        btn.classList.remove("bibtex-copied");
      }, 1500);
    }

    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(showCopied).catch(function () {
        window.prompt("Copy this BibTeX entry:", text);
      });
    } else {
      // very old browsers without the Clipboard API
      window.prompt("Copy this BibTeX entry:", text);
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- Publications search/filter box: a single text input that narrows
     the list to entries whose title/author/journal/year text matches
     every word typed (a simple client-side AND-of-substrings match,
     no backend needed for ~40 entries). Whole ## sections (Peer-
     reviewed, Conference abstracts, In preparation) collapse away if
     none of their entries match, so the page never shows an empty
     section heading. -->
<script>
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById("pub-search-input");
  var countEl = document.getElementById("pub-search-count");
  var noResultsEl = document.getElementById("pub-no-results");
  if (!input) return;

  var entries = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".pub-entry")).map(function (el) {
    return { el: el, text: el.textContent.toLowerCase() };
  });
  var sections = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("section.level2"));
  var total = entries.length;

  function applyFilter() {
    var raw = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    var words = raw.length ? raw.split(/\s+/) : [];
    var visibleCount = 0;

    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      var matches = words.every(function (w) { return entry.text.indexOf(w) !== -1; });
      entry.el.classList.toggle("pub-hidden", !matches);
      if (matches) visibleCount++;
    });

    // Hide a whole section (its heading + intro note included, since
    // both live inside the same <section class="level2"> wrapper)
    // when every entry inside it has been filtered out.
    sections.forEach(function (section) {
      var sectionEntries = section.querySelectorAll(".pub-entry");
      if (!sectionEntries.length) return; // not a publications section
      var anyVisible = Array.prototype.some.call(sectionEntries, function (el) {
        return !el.classList.contains("pub-hidden");
      });
      section.classList.toggle("pub-hidden", !anyVisible);
    });

    if (countEl) {
      countEl.textContent = raw.length ? visibleCount + " of " + total + " publications shown" : "";
    }
    if (noResultsEl) {
      noResultsEl.hidden = visibleCount !== 0 || !raw.length;
    }
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", applyFilter);
})();
</script>
